purpose: Replaces the abandoned 'cheap judge as sole arbiter' qualification gate (pm-v1.5-v5.2-external-e6-gemini-pilot-v1 and pm-v1.5-v5.2-external-e6-haiku-pilot-v1, both FAIL on quality/risk agreement with the GPT-4o anchor) with a calibration-and-robustness design. E6 no longer tries to certify a cheap model as an independent judge; it reports three separate, non-merged signals so the paper's response quality/risk claim can be checked for judge-family robustness, while E7 human review remains the primary quality/risk evidence.

design.gemini_full_scale: gemini-2.5-flash (training_judge_gemini_flash) judges the ENTIRE already-frozen pm-v1.5-v5.2-external-e6-response-judge-plan-v2 call plan (judge_call_plan_private.jsonl, 1042 batched calls, 564 quality + 478 risk, batches of 4 items each). This plan is reused byte-for-byte; it is not rebuilt or re-sampled.
design.gpt4o_calibration_sample: gpt-4o (final_judge) judges only the items whose underlying (state, table, real call_id) also appear in the frozen E7 human-review sample (outputs/pm_v1_5_v5_2_external_e7_human_review_v1_candidate): 256 distinct quality comparisons and 186 distinct risk surfaces. This is a deterministic match on real call_ids already fixed before this contract existed, not a fresh draw and not chosen after seeing any judge outcome.
design.reporting: Three pairwise agreement statistics are computed and reported separately, never merged into a single 'gold' label: Gemini-vs-GPT4o (computable immediately after both runs complete), Gemini-vs-Human and GPT4o-vs-Human (computable only after E7 human annotation exports land; this contract does not gate on that and may be aggregated in a later, separate step once those exports exist).
design.note_on_prior_pilots: pm-v1.5-v5.2-external-e6-gemini-pilot-v1 and pm-v1.5-v5.2-external-e6-haiku-pilot-v1 remain sealed as FAIL diagnostics for the sole-arbiter qualification question. They are not reopened, not rescored, and their thresholds are not changed by this contract.

in_scope: run the existing frozen E6-response Gemini judge plan at full scale
build and freeze a deterministic GPT-4o calibration call plan matched to the E7 human-review sample by real call_id
compute and freeze a real token/cost estimate before any paid execution
compute Gemini-vs-GPT4o pairwise agreement on the matched calibration subset
out_of_scope_forbidden: changing the 0.70 / 0.80 / 0.50 qualification thresholds established in v1_5_judge_qualification.py
reopening or rescoring the two sealed pilot results
modifying PM, retriever, generator, executor, Strategy Bank, prompt, seed, or external data
forcing Gemini/GPT-4o/Human into a single merged consensus label
using this calibration run's own outcomes to pick or prune the calibration sample

matching_method.quality: join E7 private_quality_key.jsonl (comparator_call_id, learned_call_id) against E6 quality_key_private.jsonl base-variant rows normalized the same way; verified 256/256 exact match, 0 ambiguous
matching_method.risk: join E7 private_risk_key.jsonl propagates_to_call_ids against E6 risk_key_private.jsonl propagates_to_call_ids via a call_id -> judge_item_id index; verified 186/186 exact match, 0 ambiguous
